# TailAdmin attribution

The BlazePwifi v0.4 admin dashboard uses a custom, trimmed local visual system inspired by the layout and component language of TailAdmin Community Edition.

Upstream: TailAdmin/tailadmin-free-tailwind-dashboard-template  
License: MIT  
The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

BlazePwifi does **not** ship TailAdmin's Node/Webpack build runtime on OpenWrt. The router serves a small static CSS/JavaScript implementation designed for constrained devices.
